source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Log in to BIOS when no password setting
2. Set an Administrator password (Within the defined range)
3. Save change and reset
4. Log in to BIOS with wrong password (3 times)
5. Log in to BIOS with correct Administrator password
6. Clear Administrator password (Set new password without enter any word)
7. Save change and reset
8. Log in to BIOS again without password

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. System should boot into BIOS when no password setting
2. Password should be set within the deined range with supported characters
3. System should not be able to enter BIOS with wrong password
4. System should boot into BIOS with correct password
5. Password should be clear successfully

original_test_intent: Unresolved: the item identifies User Password, while the full set/wrong-attempt/correct-entry/clear lifecycle explicitly operates Administrator Password.
original_method: After the tested role is corrected, manually capture passwordless BIOS entry, set that exact role within approved rules, save/reset, make exactly three approved wrong attempts, authenticate correctly, clear the same role, save/reset and verify passwordless entry.
manual_activity: Once corrected, the complete password lifecycle is a human BIOS Security-page operation. No agent may infer the role, enter/store the secret, or claim the authentication result.
required_inputs: Corrected item/procedure/criteria or case-specific owner directive
Exactly permitted wrong-attempt count and lockout behavior
Console/OOB recovery and final cleared-state owner
safety_requirements: Do not execute any password action while the role conflict remains.
Never record or expose the temporary secret in logs, screenshots or commands.
After correction, perform exactly three wrong attempts only; no automatic or fourth retry.
Verify the documented recovery path before setting a password.
Stop on unexpected prompt, role mismatch or lockout; do not clear CMOS or use unapproved recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Preserve the source conflict and prepare a redacted evidence checklist after owner correction.
Collect non-secret platform/firmware identity and health only.
Organize operator results without handling credentials or deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Decide whether the case tests User Password or Administrator Password and correct the expected prompt/criteria.
Approve password rules, three-attempt behavior, secret handling and recovery.
Perform the BIOS lifecycle and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly avoids a software command but selects User Password from the item without resolving the contradictory Administrator Password procedure.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No command or UI sequence may be executed until the role is resolved; retain a manual, redacted, role-specific lifecycle afterward.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Three wrong attempts, two save/reset points, final passwordless entry, no-script state and 15/15-minute fields are preserved pending role correction.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After owner correction, use a redacted state-transition record: no password -> exact role set -> three wrong attempts rejected -> correct entry accepted -> same role cleared -> passwordless re-entry.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS version and role documentation.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-corrected case and platform password/lockout specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit role continuity, redaction and recovery gates without changing the ordered lifecycle.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Cannot be assessed until the role is resolved.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Testing the wrong role can produce a credible but invalid result and can lock out BIOS access.

project_override_considerations: A project may provide its supported password rules and recovery process, but a project parameter cannot silently choose between contradictory master-source roles. The owner must record a case-specific decision or source correction.
expected_evidence: Platform identity and role-specific password policy
Redacted ordered captures for set, exactly three wrong attempts, correct entry and clear
Final passwordless BIOS entry and normal health
Engineer verdict with no secret disclosure

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items names User Password, but steps 2, 5 and 6 explicitly name Administrator Password and the remaining authentication steps inherit that role. The roles have distinct security effects; choosing either would rewrite a source fact.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Safe execution and a valid verdict require the exact password role. This is an unresolved operation-semantic conflict, not merely a missing SPEC or project parameter.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its manual/security boundary but rejects its unexamined User Password assumption.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with the genuine conflict and execution block, while formalizing V3.1 status/verdict separation and project-input boundaries.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Records a scoped engineering decision and preserves all safe analysis so unrelated reviews continue.

review_improvement: Prevents a manual Administrator Password test from being mislabeled as User Password coverage and prevents unsafe credential actions under ambiguous recovery semantics.
independent_technical_reasoning: The contradiction changes the security principal under test, not just wording. Because the agent cannot determine which role is authoritative without discarding either Items or repeated Procedure facts, SOURCE_CONFLICT and BLOCKED are required until an owner ruling exists.
no_automatic_retry: No password attempt is allowed before resolution; afterward do not exceed the three specified wrong attempts or repeat any stage automatically.
